errors.text_span: Етикетите за годините са изписани вертикално
errors.evidence: The description states that the year labels on the x-axis are written vertically, but they are oriented horizontally.
The description of the Y-axis is incomplete. It does not mention the numerical range from 0 to 4000, nor the interval of the major tick marks, which are set at every 500 units.

The description completely omits the core content of the figure. It fails to describe the legend and the individual data lines, including their styles (e.g., solid, dashed, dotted), their corresponding categories (Общо, ЕС, Извън ЕС), and their trends across the years. The prompt specifically requires a description of each line.
